subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff: template choice, signatory matrix, and evidence
messages:
From: Lena Cho <lena.cho@cloudscale.io>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.turner@cloudscale.io
Date: Sat, 21 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff and template preference

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to move forward. Attaching our current MSA and the order form so we can get contracting started. A few asks from procurement/legal to help us align quickly: 

- Can you confirm whether Redwood prefers using your standard MSA template or if you can take our MSA as the starting point?
- We need a signatory matrix for both parties (who signs Order Form vs MSA).
- Data residency: we will need an EU-tenant option for some PII; please flag any residency limitations or multiregion options and the related pricing if applicable.
- SOC 2 report and encryption/KMS details — procurement will request evidence.

I attached: CloudScale_MSA_v1.docx, CloudScale_OrderForm_2025.xlsx.

Goal: get a draft redline back in ~3 business days if possible. Procurement contact is procurement@cloudscale.io and Ben Turner (cc) is leading the commercial side.

Thanks —
Lena Cho
Senior Procurement Manager | CloudScale
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Cho <lena.cho@cloudscale.io>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jun 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff and template preference

Hi Lena — great to hear from you and thanks for sending the docs. Looping in Kimberly from Legal and Jordan (AE) so we can coordinate scope and billing. Next steps from our side: 

1) Legal will confirm whether we take your MSA as a starting point or propose Redwood's standard template. Either is fine — tradeoff is speed vs template alignment.
2) Please fill the attached party-sheet (I'll share a template) with signers and billing contact + expected seat counts so we can populate the Order Form cleanly.
3) We will attach SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short KMS/HSM FAQ. Kimberly, can your team indicate any high-priority clauses to flag for CloudScale?

We aim to return an initial redline within 3 business days after we receive the completed party-sheet and confirmation on template preference. If procurement needs an accelerated timeline let us know.

Quick links: Redwood intake checklist: https://drive.google.com/intl/en_redwood/msaintake-checklist (internal)

Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0110

Attachments referenced: Party-Sheet-CloudScale.xlsx (fillable), Redwood-Intake-Checklist.pdf (internal)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Cho <lena.cho@cloudscale.io>, camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 22 Jun 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff and template preference

Hi Lena / Camila — thanks for the packet. A few items Legal will prioritize when drafting the first redline (to help CloudScale prioritize internal reviewers):

- Liability cap (we typically propose 3x fees or $5M floor; let us know if CloudScale has a different commercial constraint).
- IP & ownership: confirm whether CloudScale requires any custom IP carveouts for models (we typically keep model outputs and service IP as described in our standard clause).
- Data residency / residency carveouts: if EU-only tenant required, we need to capture it on the Order Form and confirm hosting region(s).
- Subprocessors and flow-downs: provide a short list of any required vendor restrictions (e.g., no third-party analytics).
- Termination clauses and transition assistance (90 days of export assistance is standard for us; we can be flexible on timelines).

Additional asks from procurement/legal side:
- Please complete the Party-Sheet-CloudScale.xlsx so we have legal entity names, signatory names/titles, billing address, and tax ID (if applicable).
- If CloudScale requires a purchase order, include the PO format and billing contact.

I attached a blank Party-Sheet-CloudScale.xlsx and a short SOC2 evidence index. Once we receive the filled party sheet and confirmation on template preference, Legal will produce a redline and a clause summary (highlighting deviations) within ~3 business days.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Contracts Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Party-Sheet-CloudScale.xlsx (fillable), SOC2-evidence-index.pdf (redacted)

From: Lena Cho <lena.cho@cloudscale.io>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.turner@cloudscale.io, procurement@cloudscale.io
Date: Sun, 22 Jun 2025 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff and template preference

Camila / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turn. We'll proceed as follows: 

- Procurement prefers Redwood's standard MSA as the starting point if it reduces review cycles; please send your template redline.
- I've filled out the party-sheet with preliminary signers and tax ID — attaching now (Party-Sheet-CloudScale_Filled.xlsx).
- Procurement contact for PO is procurement@cloudscale.io (same as above); billing contact is Ben Turner. We will also attach the PO number in the next email.
- Quick question on KMS: we use AWS KMS with a customer-managed key. Do you support external CMKs / HSM integration or require Redwood-managed keys? If you can send the KMS FAQ you mentioned, that would be helpful.

We expect to be ready for an internal legal review by Wednesday. If Redwood can return a redline of your template by Wednesday EOD that would keep us on track to sign the following week.

Appreciate the collaboration —
Lena

Attachments: Party-Sheet-CloudScale_Filled.xlsx, CloudScale_PO_instructions.pdf
